en.cloud.sandbox.screen.label: Computer screen
en.cloud.sandbox.screen.preview-note: The screen will appear here once the Cloud Computer's desktop is ready.
en.cloud.sandbox.screen.not-installed: This Cloud Computer has no desktop.
en.cloud.sandbox.screen.install-pending: The desktop arrives with this project's next Cloud Computer.
en.cloud.sandbox.screen.stream-off: Showing the screen is turned off for this project.
en.cloud.sandbox.screen.unavailable: The screen isn't available for this Cloud Computer.
en.cloud.settings.computer.title: Cloud Computer
en.cloud.settings.computer.detail: Choose what your Cloud Computer for this project provides. These choices are yours alone.
en.cloud.settings.computer.desktopHelp: A desktop with a browser. Takes effect when this project's next Cloud Computer is created.
en.cloud.settings.computer.desktopPending: Changed. Takes effect when this project's next Cloud Computer is created.
en.cloud.settings.computer.streamHelp: Show the desktop in this app. When off, the screen is never sent to this computer.
en.cloud.settings.computer.failed: Couldn't update the Cloud Computer. Try again.
en.settings.experimental.cloudComputerScree: Show the Cloud Computer's screen below the files of Cloud projects. Until its desktop is ready, the screen is a preview.

zh-Hans.cloud.sandbox.screen.label: 电脑屏幕
zh-Hans.cloud.sandbox.screen.preview-note: 云电脑桌面就绪后，屏幕会显示在这里。
zh-Hans.cloud.sandbox.screen.not-installed: 这台云电脑没有安装桌面。
zh-Hans.cloud.sandbox.screen.install-pending: 桌面会随这个项目的下一台云电脑一起安装。
zh-Hans.cloud.sandbox.screen.stream-off: 这个项目已关闭屏幕传输。
zh-Hans.cloud.sandbox.screen.unavailable: 这台云电脑暂不支持屏幕。
zh-Hans.cloud.settings.computer.title: 云电脑
zh-Hans.cloud.settings.computer.detail: 选择你在这个项目里的云电脑提供哪些功能。这些设置只影响你自己的云电脑。
zh-Hans.cloud.settings.computer.desktopHelp: 带浏览器的桌面。在这个项目的下一台云电脑创建时生效。
zh-Hans.cloud.settings.computer.desktopPending: 已更改，在这个项目的下一台云电脑创建时生效。
zh-Hans.cloud.settings.computer.streamHelp: 在 App 里显示桌面。关闭后，屏幕画面不会传到这台电脑。
zh-Hans.cloud.settings.computer.failed: 云电脑设置没能保存，请重试。
zh-Hans.settings.experimental.cloudComputerScree: 在云端项目的文件列表下方显示云电脑屏幕。桌面就绪前显示为预览。
